items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now Gashun, is that Joe Phillips? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, Gashun is, well that's all I would do, but I knew his father was a bass player.

ctx.x: Well they could, but he stuck most of the music. They always did, stuck most of the music. Like I said, the band on the Pelican, we had music, but we had head numbers we did and everything, yeah. Now, and we'll get back to the same thing on the Pelican. And those three and four piece bands they used to have up there. I remember there was a band that used to come up there, there was a guy named One Eye Babe who played bass and that was Gashun's father. And they had what they used to call them, when the band could…
Now Gashun, is that Joe Phillips?
No, no, Gashun is, well that's all I would do, but I knew his father was a bass player. They called him One Eye Babe, and that old man could pull some- Gashun drives for-
